title: Payment record collections and field directory
content:
All collections use id as primary key. customer_id is enforced by the system. Query xp_cases for the signed-in customer's business context. Filters are exact equality or {"in": [...]}, {"contains": "text"}, {"gte": value}, {"lte": value}. Pages include summaries and a next_cursor; get_record returns the full public record. The directory describes all products, so a valid collection can have no records for this customer.
